format: Traditional Restaurant at an endcap or inline shopping center location (about 3,100 to 3,500 sq ft, leased, with drive-thru); freestanding costs $1,282,525 to $2,575,400

invest.quote: Total Initial Investment22 $910,175 $1,816,100 (Restaurant at an Endcap or Inline Shopping Center Location). Cover: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a franchised Restaurant ranges from $910,175 to $2,575,400. This includes $35,851 to $118,158 that must be paid to us or our affiliates.

fee.quote: When you sign a Franchise Agreement, you must pay us an initial franchise fee of $35,500 (the “Initial Franchise Fee”).
fee.note: VetFran: Initial Franchise Fee is $20,000 for qualifying veterans or members of the Armed Forces. Case-by-case reductions (additional units, reopening, multi-unit operators). During 2025 franchisees paid $10,000 to $35,500. Grand opening advertising minimum $25,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 5% of Net Sales. Payable weekly on the date specified in the Manuals (the “Payment Due Date”)

adFund.quote: Advertising Contribution Currently, 2% of Net Sales. ... We may increase the Advertising Contribution up to 3% of Net Sales by notice to franchisees at any time.
adFund.note: Currently 2%, up to 3%. Local Marketing Obligation currently not less than 0.75% of Net Sales each calendar quarter. Advertising Cooperative contribution may also apply.

otherRecurring.name: POS System License and Lease Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $351 to $456 per month under the CapEx Program and $743 to $1,358 per month under the HaaS Program

otherRecurring.name: Ordering Support Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, 3% of the pre-tax transaction amount for each transaction that is processed through our online ordering system

otherRecurring.name: Online Ordering Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $141 per month, plus a per transaction fee (currently, 0.04% per transaction)

otherRecurring.name: Supply Chain Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $0.60 to $0.90 per case purchased through certain Appointed Distributors

otherRecurring.name: Sublease Administration Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $200 per month (only if you sublease a Restaurant from us)

transferFee.amount: 50% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee if it is a Control Transfer; if it is a transfer to a related party or that is not a Control Transfer, 10% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee.

special: Several ancillary fees are paid to the franchisor or affiliates (Ordering Support Fee 3% of online ordering transactions, POS license/lease fees passed through at cost plus 0.5% admin, supply chain fee per case collected from distributors). Subleasing from the franchisor adds a $200 monthly Sublease Administration Fee on top of rent. Item 7 includes only one month of rent; buying land for a freestanding Restaurant estimated at $500,000 to $1,000,000.
issues: Item 19 intro defines eligible franchises by 'all 52 weeks of Fiscal Year 2024' though the table is Fiscal Year 2025 (apparent typo). Item 19 counts 505 Traditional Franchises vs 533 franchised outlets in Item 20 (non-traditional included). Transfer fee not printed in dollars (50% of $35,500 would be $17,750).
